ja486:1.1: Ukkā milācā bandhanti dīpe, pajā mamaṃ khādituṃ patthayanti, mittaṃ sahāyañ ca vadehi senaka, ācikkha ñātivyasanaṃ dijānan ti.
ja486:2.1: Dijo dijānaṃ pavaro si pakkhi, ukkusarāja saraṇan taṃ upemi, pajā mamaṃ khādituṃ patthayanti luddā milācā, bhava me sukhāyā 'ti.
ja486:3.1: Mittaṃ sahāyañ ca karonti paṇḍitā kāle akāle sukham āsayānā, karomi te senaka etam atthaṃ, ariyo hi ariyassa karoti kiccan ti.
ja486:4.1: Yaṃ hoti kiccaṃ anukampakena ariyassa ariyena kataṃ tava-y-idaṃ, attānurakkhī bhava mā aḍayha, lacchāma putte tayi jīvamāne
ja486:5.1: ti. Tav' eva rakkhāvaraṇaṃ karonto sarīrabhedāpi na santasāmi, karonti h' ete sakhinaṃ sakhāro: pāṇaṃ cajanti, satān' esa dhammo ti.
ja486:6.1: Sudukkaraṃ kammam akā aṇḍaj' āyaṃ vihaṅgamo atthāya kuraro putte aḍḍharatte anāgate ti.
ja486:7.1: Cutāpi eke khalita-ssakammunā mittānukampāya patiṭṭhahanti, puttā mam' aṭṭā, gatiṃ āgato 'smi, atthaṃ caretha mama vārichannā 'ti.
ja486:8.1: Dhanena dhaññena ca attanā va mittaṃ sahāyañ ca karonti paṇḍitā, karomi te senaka etam atthaṃ, ariyo hi ariyassa karoti kiccan ti.
ja486:9.1: Appossukko tāta tuvaṃ nisīda, putto pitu caratī atthacariyaṃ, ahaṃ carissāmi tav' etam atthaṃ senassa putte paritāyamāno ti.
ja486:10.1: Addhā hi tāta satān' esa dhammo putto pitu yaṃ caretha atthacariyaṃ, app-eva maṃ disvā pavaddhakāyaṃ senassa puttā na viheṭhayeyyun ti.
ja486:11.1: Pasū manussā mīgaviriyaseṭṭha bhayadditā seṭṭham upabbajanti, puttā mam' aṭṭā, gatim āgato 'smi, tvan no si rājā, bhave me sukhāyā 'ti.
ja486:12.1: Karomi te senaka etam atthaṃ, āyāma te taṃ disataṃ vadhāya, kathaṃ hi viññū bahu sampajāno na vāyame attajanassa guttiyā ti.
ja486:13.1: Mittañ ca kayirātha sakhāgharañ ca, ayirañ ca kayirātha sukhehi ayiro, nivatthakojo va sare 'bhihantvā modāma puttehi samaṅgibhūtā.
ja486:14.1: Sakamittassa kammena sahāyassāpalāyino kūjantaṃ upakūjanti lomasā hadayaṅgamaṃ.
ja486:15.1: Mittaṃ sahāyaṃ adhigamma paṇḍito so bhuñjatī puttapasuṃ dhanaṃ vā, ahañ ca puttā ca patī ca mayhaṃ mittānukampāya samaṅgibhūtā.
ja486:16.1: Rājāvatā sūravatā ca attho, sampannasakkhissa bhavanti h' ete, yo mittavā yasavā uggatatto asmiñ ca loke modati kāmakāmi.
ja486:17.1: Karaṇīyāni mittāni daliddenāpi senaka, passa mittānukampāya samagg' amhā sa ñātake.
ja486:18.1: Sūrena balavantena yo mettiṃ kurute dijo evaṃ so sukhito hoti yathāham tvaṃ ca senakā 'ti.
